agents.notes: Owns routing, integration, risky review, and hardware evidence.
agents.notes_zh: 负责任务路由、最终集成、高风险审查和硬件证据。

agents.notes: Default first-line developer for low-risk, bounded, testable tasks. May edit, test, commit, push, and open PRs in its own clone; no image input.
agents.notes_zh: 低风险、边界清晰、可测试任务的默认一线开发 Agent。可在独立 clone 中修改、测试、提交、推送和创建 PR；不能识图。

agents.notes: Use for screenshots, datasheets, architecture, and independent review; do not assume local file access.
agents.notes_zh: 适合截图、数据手册、架构和独立审查；不能默认具备本地文件访问能力。

agents.notes: Local implementation with the current DeepSeek API; no image input.
agents.notes_zh: 通过当前 DeepSeek API 做本地实现；不能识图。
